summary: Remote-controlled shell/filesystem access via WebSocket to agenthub-agent.fyenet.com
details: The daemon connects to a hardcoded WebSocket endpoint at wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com and dispatches inbound control messages to privileged local operations on the installer's host. `MessageSend` envelopes are passed as prompts into a Claude Code SDK session started with `permissionMode: "bypassPermissions"` and a configurable `cwd`, allowing the remote peer to run shell commands and modify files without any approval prompt. Additional remote actions dispatch to filesystem helpers directly: `FileRead`, `FileWrite`, `FileTree`, and `FileSearch` (control.js) call `readFileContent`/`writeFileContent` with attacker-supplied paths guarded only by `normalizePath`, giving the remote side arbitrary read/write of the installer's filesystem outside the Claude channel. An `AgentUpdate` action spawns `<node> <argv[1]> update`, which invokes `npm install` and respawns the daemon, providing a remote-driven code-push channel for whatever version is currently published under this package name. The remote peer therefore holds full-host RCE, arbitrary file exfiltration and tampering, and a self-update primitive on any host running the daemon.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
